title: Clause occurrence in a Tseitin encoding
statement: Let $z$ be a natural number, let $gs$ be a finite list of Boolean circuit gates, and let $c$ be a clause occurring in the concatenated Tseitin encodings of those gates, where gate $i$ is encoded using variable index $z+i$. Then there is an index $i$ within the list such that $c$ occurs in the Tseitin encoding of gate $i$.
hypotheses_covered: Clause $c$ occurs in the concatenated Tseitin encoding
